mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return exceeds 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered periods compared to non-triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is simultaneously rising signals contractionary supply shocks, which depress earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1% AND UNRATE monthly change > 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not statistically different from zero.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid reduction in the federal funds rate below 2% during a recession (UNRATE > 5%) signals aggressive monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered episodes compared to non-triggered recession periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal income (implied by PAYEMS growth > 0.5% for three consecutive months) signals improving consumer purchasing power, which boosts demand and supports higher corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, accompanied by a concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 0.8%, signals a deteriorating labor and production environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change < -0.5% AND INDPRO monthly change < -0.8%
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes compared to non-triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal savings (implied by RSAFS growth > 0.3% for four consecutive months) without a corresponding rise in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1 flat) indicates pent-up savings that have not yet translated into demand, suggesting muted earnings growth and neutral S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change > 0.3% for 4 consecutive months AND GDPC1 monthly change ≈ 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are significantly negative during triggered episodes at 5% significance.
